availability_message: All historical questions are retained. Target-syllabus practice excludes only the listed unsupported-recall question/part exceptions. Other parts remain available, including AS prerequisites in P4 and supplied novel contexts. Original reference data may still be needed; final player/source-fidelity review is separate.

availability_provenance.method: Whole-syllabus curricular screen using contextual content reviews, explicit unsupported-recall checks, and question/MS context; not an official Cambridge historical availability register.
availability_provenance.marked_unit_policy: P1 MCQ or existing assessed theory leaf is atomic. A mixed leaf requiring unsupported recall is excluded in full; no official marking points or marks are rewritten.

reference_documents.title: Cambridge Chemistry historical Data Booklet (2016-2018)
reference_documents.purpose: Historical data supplied for original Papers 1, 2 and 4. Use this edition for the archived paper; it is not an answer or a target-syllabus change.

answer_key_source: Official answers are preserved in each question markscheme.json and the source mark-scheme PDF.
